name: Trial by Chat
summary:
Trial by Chat is a crowd-judged party game built for Twitch streamers. Players answer a prompt with the funniest card in their hand, but instead of players judging each other, live chat decides the winner. Every viewer, across every connected streamer's channel, votes in real time using simple chat commands.

Play solo with your own community, or team up with other streamers for a true crossover session where every connected chat votes together. An OBS-ready overlay displays the game live on stream, and hosts get full control over game settings, pacing, and content.

Trial by Chat is designed specifically to boost chat engagement and interaction, turning passive viewers into active participants in every round.
